label: Taylor series centred at zero
subgoals: A Maclaurin series is a Taylor series with centre zero.
Write the coefficients as derivatives at zero divided by factorials.

label: Standard Maclaurin series
subgoals: The exponential function expands with reciprocal factorial coefficients.
Sine and cosine alternate signs and use odd or even powers.

label: Building new series
subgoals: Substitute a multiple of x into a known series.
Integrate or differentiate a series term by term inside its radius.
